angle.title: Verified Local Plumbers with Real‑Time Scheduling and Direct Support
angle.idea: Only onboard plumbers who pass a background check and prove a physical local address, display real‑time availability, and provide in‑app chat/phone support staffed 24/7 to handle lead disputes, cancellations, and billing issues instantly.

people.after_reason: The app's real‑time scheduling would stop the no‑follow‑up problem I faced.
